emailBuilderViewportGate.title: The editor needs a bigger screen
emailBuilderViewportGate.body: Drag-and-drop editing doesn't fit on a phone. Open this on a tablet or desktop to make changes — everything you've saved is exactly as you left it.

emailSubjectSettingsCard.title: Subject & Preview Text

emailSubjectSettingsCard.subjectHelp: The subject line recipients will see in their inbox.
emailSubjectSettingsCard.previewTextHelp: The preview text appears after the subject line in email clients. Keep it under 150 characters.

templateHistoryPanel.confirmDescription: This email has edits you haven't saved. Restoring loads the older version onto the canvas — you can undo it, but the restore itself is not saved until you save.
